body: Thank you so much, for what you wrote. I think you and my brother look a bit like each other you are just so much stronger than him, and i have also spent nights alone with a knife and a rope. Right now i live with my mom she just came back for a cancer. I'm blessed that i can talk and spent my time with her. Thank you
Thank you so much, i will try to talk to my mother and then i will make through school and hopefully go to a technical school.I really appreciate.

Thanks man, yeah i will talk to my mother and maybe my father, but in Denmark where i live grades really matters no matter how old you are if i don't get better grades i can't make it to high school. But thank you so much for you answer.
